notes: Pencil, written across the roll. Region 1 carries a second pencilled number, 2524. Region 4 shows the leader label 'WELTE-MIGNON No. 1571 / Prelude / G minor / J. J. Rachmaninoff / Played by [signature]', which carries no date. Region 2 blank. No punch date found.

inscription: Carmen  G. Bizet  Played by [signature]  23. III. 09,
notes: Printed leader label with title, composer, the performer's signature and the printed date 23. III. 09. Not a workshop punch inscription: on kq525dc4373 in this batch a label of the same kind (25. III. 09) stands on a roll whose pencilled punch date is 30. 5. 23, so a label date is not the date the copy was punched. Region 1 blank roll, region 3 the box with the printed Welte-Mignon storage notice. No punch date found.
All four crops blank paper, perforations and tears. No writing.
Region 1 shows a rectangular block of very faint printing (offset or show-through from the reverse), too faint to read at this resolution; regions 2 and 3 blank. Nothing legible.
Stamped in black, no separators: 14 12 25. The 4 is blotted; the remaining figures are plain.

Ink. Two names: a second name stands to the right of the date, apparently beginning 'Hohn-', not securely legible; 'Wissler' below the date is clear apart from a bar over the middle letters, so Wossler or Wussler cannot be excluded.
Stamped in black, no separators: 14 2 25. A blotted, partly inked mark follows the digits and cannot be read; it may be a second impression.

Pencil. Region 1 carries a second pencilled group of figures reading something like 5321, which could be a date (5. 3. 21) but whose third and fourth figures are not secure, so no date is recorded. Regions 3 and 4 blank.
Pencil. The second figure of the day is the German 4 with a crossbar and could be taken for a 9; the crossbar and the absence of a closed upper loop favour 4. No name or roll number in the crop.

Pencil, written along the roll. The 3s are written with closed bowls and could be read as 8s, but 80 is impossible as a day and the year figure has the same form as the day's first figure. The month figure matches the 5s of the pencilled roll number 1755 in region 4. Region 3 shows the leader label 'WELTE-MIGNON No. 1755. Accompaniment for Sopran / Widmung (Devotion) / R. Schumann / Played by [signature] / 25. III. 09.' - a printed label date, distinct from this punch date.
Pencil. Same hand and layout as vf252dc4872, dated a day earlier. No name or roll number in the crop.

Pencil, no separators: 23 2 22. Region 2 shows the leader label 'WELTE-MIGNON No. 1772 / Kinderscenen 1-6 / R. Schumann / Played by [signature] / 28. III. 09.' - a printed label date, not the punch date. ds710xd1794, whose pencilled roll number is 1773, carries the same five figures, which fits two consecutive rolls punched on one day.

Pencil, no separators: 23 2 22. A second, smaller mark stands to the right of the figures in the same crop and is not legible. Region 2 carries the pencilled roll number 1773. jb107tz1859 (roll 1772) carries the same five figures.
Four crops: blank paper with perforations, a damp stain, and the cloth leader. No writing.
